scoreBasis: Holistic judgments of the submitted plan, not test pass rates: factual baseline/preservation and operator rulings are substantially correct, but consumer exclusions, hunk coverage and requirement evidence are materially overstated. Execution readiness is lower because the Windows target, full-suite phase dependency, restoration safety and real snapshot/AC4 exits are unresolved. The review also has separate credential-handling and primary-persistence defects. Neither score reaches 98.

findings.evidence: Every pinned file was SHA256-rehashed and its byte length compared before subject analysis. All 17 matched, including plan D96E9860..., patch 90604E39..., and SELF-REVIEW 8FF62752....
findings.rationale: The review addresses the exact submitted artifact, not a reconstructed plan.
findings.correction: Retain these pins and disclose any change before another round.

findings.evidence: state-before.json: develop dca4a6239cab0515498941f2469ee42115e77f3d; gitlink and native HEAD cc67418cba58e71d8e70fd353e9de47199ad2075; 8 specified tracked modifications, 222 insertions, 8 deletions; no staged native diff. Native git dir is the absolute equivalent of .git/modules/native/vice.
findings.rationale: The SHA, tracked file list, diff totals, and local exclude location agree with live read-only git evidence.
findings.correction: Keep fresh per-host measurements at D0; the separate untracked-count defect is F01.

findings.evidence: Sections 3 and 4 explicitly choose .gitmodules ignore=untracked, retain all untracked paths, and replace the original empty submodule-status exit with equality to the classified D0 inventory. Handoff v2 line 266 records the operator choosing this amendment.
findings.rationale: The submodule itself may still show untracked files. That is authorized, and does not justify demanding info/exclude or deletion.
findings.correction: Preserve this policy. Remove contradictory leftover exclude-file work under F11.

findings.evidence: The plan defers implementation done-state HV and status changes to sequence step 12. The current request explicitly supplies the 12:21 ruling that plans still receive hostile review. No implementation step is claimed executed here.
findings.rationale: This review is authorized. D3 does not create an HV-before-code-complete deadlock for this plan review, and postpones done-state review rather than waiving substantive gates.
findings.correction: Keep the distinction between plan approval, execution evidence, and final done-state acceptance explicit.

findings.evidence: Linux desktop-install README lines 13-24 and Windows 20261020T121000 desktop-install README lines 7-25 record Nuke deployment/install of version 1.3.111, ProductVersion commit 2c8d60284229b9fedc2d50f840153b9e8d8cbcbf, binary hashes and successful command outputs. Windows InstallMsi depends on PublishMsi.
findings.rationale: Both recorded installations use the approved Nuke route and the same commit. Neither receipt claims a GUI launch. This review did not independently inspect either installed application.
findings.correction: D-pre must still identify the accepted build at execution entry; see A02.

findings.section: Bounded Phase C builder and observation evidence
findings.evidence: The S2b receipt and builder source place work/build/bin outputs under artifacts/immutable-vice/<sha>, outside native/vice. S4 receipt lines 20-28 reports Linux 100k/1M and display-on 4M observations, equivalence checks, hashes and stolen-cycle counts. Handoff v2 lines 263 and 267 records Windows six-stage build and 1M results, with Windows 4M deferred.
findings.rationale: There is evidence for external building, cycle control, and bounded observer traces. It proves neither a replacement DLL ABI nor snapshot resume or managed parity.
findings.correction: Keep those limits attached to any Phase C reuse; F04, F05 and F10 address overclaims.

findings.section: Authorized preservation and narrow restoration intent
findings.evidence: D0 copies modified tracked files and injected source into per-host receipts; D4 requires a committed preservation receipt and individual checkout paths; reset --hard and clean are prohibited; untracked files remain. Oct 4 receipt patch and header hashes verify, and its inventory has 2,527 entries.
findings.rationale: This reconciles restoration with copy/hash/retain and the amendment superseding removal of classified generated paths. R2/R3 expressly authorize retirement of the named legacy builders outside the submodule.
findings.correction: Add the drift and interruption outcomes in F07 before any destructive checkout.

findings.evidence: git -C native/vice status --porcelain=v1 -uall yields 163 entries: 8 tracked modifications and 155 untracked paths. The plan says 135 untracked. Handoff v2 line 174 also records 155.
findings.rationale: A preservation plan cannot describe an incomplete source inventory as measured fact. The difference is 20 paths, not a changed input pin.
findings.correction: Correct the baseline to 155 and make D0 enumerate hidden paths and ordinary paths completely, with explicit counts and classifications on each host.

findings.evidence: ViceSharp.TestHarness.csproj lines 10 and 68-72 names Vice.Native.proj and invokes its BuildNative target on Windows whenever the project exists. D2 removes that target; the alternative of removing the project is conditional on no references, but this reference exists.
findings.rationale: The stated target-removal branch leaves an MSBuild call to a nonexistent target, so the Windows solution build cannot satisfy D2 as written. The plan measured only build/*.cs and omitted this caller.
findings.correction: Make the harness property/target/call disposition an explicit D2 edit, update the blast radius, and prove Windows and Linux managed builds no longer invoke the retired native path. Do not rebuild the dirty shim.

findings.evidence: rg -l ViceNativeBridge tests finds 31 C# files, including helpers. CpuValidationTests lines 7-8/28-67, SidExactOracleTests lines 17-18/38 onward, and C64VkmKeyboardTests lines 180-219 contain native tests with no excluded Category. Build.cs line 112 excludes only Determinism, AiReview, ParityPending, ParityLegacy and Integration. ViceFactAttribute lines 15-16 and ViceTheoryAttribute lines 15-16 skip when the library is absent.
findings.rationale: The claim that every affected test is already excluded is false. Removing availability yields selected skips, or failures in unconditional consumers. Retiring a builder also does not make an existing dirty DLL disappear; the retained runtime resolver can still select it.
findings.correction: Inventory direct and indirect x64/xvic consumers and stale binary resolution, define each authorized disposition and Phase E/F owner, and lock an explicit gate denominator with zero required skips. Do not count a retained patched DLL as immutable evidence or silently broaden exclusions.

findings.evidence: The Oct 4 patch lines 53-66 zero-initializes drive attach/detach clock arrays; lines 74-96 resets cycle_accum on non-snapshot drive resets. X64ScSnapshotCompatibility.cs lines 32-88 only validates the VSF envelope and inserts missing MAINCPU fields, preserving other module bytes. Patch lines 466-503 also changes VIC sound divide/index behavior, while lines 178-212 contains a MAINCPU version-read hunk absent from the classification.
findings.rationale: The drive changes are behavior/reset corrections, not normalization already rehomed by 199 adapter tests. The sound file also contains more than probes. The claimed complete disposition and the all-needs-served inference are unsupported.
findings.correction: D0/D3 must classify every hunk by actual behavior, identify the existing MAINCPU adapter coverage precisely, and explicitly reject native corrections or name approved managed follow-up requirements. An uncovered required behavior is a blocker before D4, not proof supplied by the 199-test count.

findings.section: D1/D5 VSF Slice 1 and Phase C S5 handoff
findings.evidence: PLAN-OBSERVER-001 line 30 defers a real snapshot MAINCPU clock/register cross-check to Phase D. PLAN-VSFLOCKSTEP-001 lines 321-350 includes legacy native resume, current native round-trip, fixtures, state manifest and cumulative NativeSnapshotCompatibilityTest. The subject names only builder/prerequisite test families and reruns observer traces plus managed suites. An observer executable does not supply the vice_x64/vice_xvic DLL ABI.
findings.rationale: D5 drops the real snapshot obligation and much of the VSF Slice 1 folded into Phase D, without an approved replacement capability or a precise handoff. Pure byte-adapter success does not prove native resume.
findings.correction: Give each existing Slice 1/S5 obligation an owning D step, immutable execution path, named test and retained evidence, including the real cross-check. If its scheduling or interface changes, amend the relevant approved plan explicitly; R2 retirement alone does not waive snapshot ACs.

findings.evidence: D2 requires Nuke Test green and D5/Exit requires the full managed/applicable suite green. Handoff v2 line 239 records 20 CPU/NMI/visible-PC failures, assigned to Phase E; Phase E entry in handoff v1 line 119 requires Phase D accepted. CpuInterruptTests and CpuVisiblePcTimingTests have no excluded Category, so the current Test filter selects them. No product changes occur in 2c8d6028..review HEAD.
findings.rationale: The plan requires Phase E-owned repairs to pass before Phase E may start, while calling Phase D cleanup only. D3 changes review timing, not this substantive green gate.
findings.correction: Resolve this dependency in the plan before execution. Identify the exact full applicable suite and approved phase ownership/order; otherwise record the gate as blocked. Do not silently filter failures or treat a diagnostic baseline as green.

findings.evidence: D4 rehashes preserved copies before and after checkout, but does not require the live delta to still match those copies before overwriting it. It gives no observable resume rule after some paths were reverted. checkout -- <path> restores the index version, while the final git diff checks only unstaged changes.
findings.rationale: A post-D0 edit, unexpected staged change, or interrupted restoration can be overwritten or misinterpreted despite the old preservation copies still hashing correctly. This is an unsafe gap, not merely an optional additional AC.
findings.correction: D4 AC: before each authorized overwrite, every affected path and index state must match its preserved approved state or the pinned already-restored state; anything else stops without overwrite. On interruption, identify completed versus untouched paths from verified bytes and resume only approved remaining paths. Test changed-live-delta, staged drift, partial completion and missing/corrupt receipt controls against a mock tree first.

findings.evidence: The bracket is stated as unchanged git status and equal untracked inventory with no new or deleted entries. D0 hashes modified tracked files and injected source; it does not state a byte/hash baseline for every retained generated file. git status does not show content changes to an existing untracked file, and a tracked file can remain M after further edits.
findings.rationale: A build overwriting an existing native/vice file can satisfy these comparisons. That cannot prove the rule that no build writes into the submodule, even though R1 B correctly permits retained untracked paths.
findings.correction: D2/D5 AC: the retained native tree has identical relevant bytes and path set across builds/runs, apart from the separately authorized D4 tracked restoration. Use a complete hash/length inventory or equivalent observable write protection, with an existing-path overwrite negative control, and stop on any discrepancy.

findings.evidence: native/build-vice-observer.ps1 line 26 and Invoke-ObserverEquivalence.ps1 line 20 use CmdletBinding() without SupportsShouldProcess or a WhatIf parameter. Both immediately create output directories. D5 calls them as existing six-stage tooling; D0 only specifies WhatIf for the new preservation script.
findings.rationale: The mandatory dry-run cannot be executed against these canonical scripts as written. Calling a behavior change tooling does not waive the explicit mocks-first and analyzer requirements.
findings.correction: Assign D1/D2 ownership for compliant preview behavior and its discriminating mock contract before modification, then analyzer-check and dry-run every state-changing script before D5. An approved existing native toolchain shell is not itself a PowerShell-language violation.

findings.section: D5/Exit TR-CYCLE-001 AC4 and original Phase D exit
findings.evidence: TR-Cycle-Accuracy.md line 44 requires CPU accesses only during PHI2 with AEC asserted. ObservationTraceValidationTests lines 130-141 asserts decoding, sequence and record counts, not managed access gating. Handoff v1 line 115 explicitly requires REAL-C64-PHI2-AEC-001 and comparator XMLDoc correction; neither appears in the subject exit. R1 B amends retained untracked status and D3 amends HV timing.
findings.rationale: S4c trace validity is useful native evidence but does not serve the complete AC4 claim. The two specified amendments do not authorize silently deleting unrelated exit items.
findings.correction: Restore a named real AC4 gate and comparator documentation task with owning steps, mocks-first assertions and real evidence, or obtain an explicit plan amendment assigning the obligation to its proper phase. Keep A1/A2 and the operator-approved AEC applicability/derivation intact.

findings.evidence: The blast radius still lists a new vice-build-output.exclude, two new PowerShell scripts and three shell scripts, and line 58 discusses the local exclude as reversible. R1 B explicitly says no exclude file/script; R2/R3 names two shell launchers and one PowerShell builder. TR-VSFLOCKSTEP-RESUME-001 AC2 still names build-vice-shim.ps1, and VSF Slice 1 validation calls both retiring builders.
findings.rationale: The self-review propagation claim misses contradictory executable instructions and an incorrect edit inventory. The plan does not assign reconciliation of the canonical builder reference and active dependent commands.
findings.correction: Make R1 B/R2 A the single current disposition, enumerate exact D2 files including the harness caller, and assign canonical requirement/plan reference updates through supported MCP/generation paths. Preserve semantics; any actual AC reduction requires its own approved requirement plan.

findings.evidence: The reviewer redacted key-value header forms but missed the marker query-string credential example, exposing a credential in tool output. The error was disclosed during the run. The credential is intentionally not reproduced here.
findings.rationale: This violated the explicit no-credential-printing instruction. It is this reviewer process failure, not an implementer plan defect.
findings.correction: Retain the raw stream privately and produce a verified redacted copy before sharing. Do not commit or publish the raw response. No credential rotation or environment repair is performed or implied by this review.

Local marker signature passed, but session-start returned MCP_UNTRUSTED/no-session. beginTurn was rejected with no sessionId; supported triage failed with Health check failed - Permission denied. Offline IDs were then allocated by plugin helpers and failsafe snapshots retained under the authorized exception.
findings.rationale: No primary reviewer session/turn, primary full-content readback, or completed-state history proof exists. A local queue readback cannot be presented as server persistence.
findings.correction: Treat this review as queued-only and incomplete for acceptance. A later authorized supported-plugin persistence and primary full-content/history readback must establish the required audit trail; do not replay historical queues or repair shared settings during this round.

findings.evidence: The canonical FR-VICE-001, TR-VICE-ORACLE-001, TEST-VICE-001, TR-VSFLOCKSTEP-RESUME-001 and TR-CYCLE-001 documents and immutable matrix were read. Supported primary trust failed before an effective-layer or current TODO query could be made.

findings.correction: Use the active supported plugin to read effective requirements and TODO state once trust is available; reconcile exact mappings and pending statuses before implementation or a done claim.

findings.evidence: D0 measures and compares the current Windows patch with Oct 4 and Linux, while section 2 makes a hunk neither covered nor rejected a blocker. It does not specify the acceptance outcome for an explained difference versus an unexplained one.
findings.rationale: Different hosts need not have byte-identical dirty deltas. The comparison should yield an explicit disposition rather than equating every difference with failure.
findings.correction: D0 AC, DeltaComparison_ClassifiesEveryCurrentHunk: all current hunks are preserved and individually mapped to an approved disposition; an explained host difference is listed, while any unclassified or required-uncovered hunk blocks D4. Prove missing-hunk and wrong-host negative controls.

findings.evidence: Both deployment receipts name 2c8d6028; review HEAD is dca4a623. Handoff v2 line 267 records Windows 1M results, Windows 4M deferred, and the later instruction to wait for the next operator instruction. This request authorizes review only.
findings.rationale: A plan approval or a remote report must not implicitly release an implementation hold or silently redefine latest installed build.
findings.correction: D-pre/D0 AC, EntryEvidence_BindsBothHostsAndExplicitRelease: record the accepted desktop commit/version on each host, exact Windows trace matrix including deferred 4M ownership, and the operator instruction releasing implementation. Until then D0 remains unexecuted. This is an operational entry check, not a new product requirement.

findings.evidence: The plan says the delta is recoverable from receipts, but its no-source-edit boundary does not authorize a later automatic reapplication of the old native patch when D5 fails.
findings.rationale: Recoverable evidence and authority to mutate the reference are different. The safe stopped state should be observable on both hosts.
findings.correction: D4/D5 AC, PostRestoreFailure_StopsWithPreservedEvidence: on a later gate failure, stop before Phase E, retain all originals/receipts, report each host and path state, and leave verified restored source pinned. No automatic dirty-patch reapply or untracked deletion; any such recovery needs the operator-scoped authority. Test failure after the first host and after both hosts.
